verdict.rationale: Svelte provides a scriptable CLI (`sv create`, `sv add`, `sv check`) and an MCP server plus llms.txt docs specifically for AI agents to consume, which supports agent-driven workflows, but there is no formal documented public API (REST/OpenAPI) — the probe explicitly found all openapi/swagger endpoints returning 404. missing for 10: a documented programmatic API spec (OpenAPI/REST), independent evidence of agents successfully driving Svelte via API beyond CLI/MCP docs.
